bluetooth.notes: The name starts with 'Galaxy Buds FE'. The ' (XXXX)' 4-character suffix follows the usual Galaxy Buds naming but no source found spelling it out for this model, so treat it as unverified. Users can rename the buds in Galaxy Wearable (Earbuds settings > About earbuds > Edit), so name matching is not reliable. GalaxyBudsClient (open source) matches by name.Contains('Buds FE') and, for Buds2 and later, prefers the SPP service UUID prefix d908aab5-7a90-4cbe-8641-86a553db + device-ID bytes. The regex must not match 'Galaxy Buds3 FE'. Galaxy Wearable app needed for extras (ANC settings, EQ). Samsung Company ID 0x0075 was not checked against a source for this model, so left null.

pairingSteps: Put both earbuds in the charging case (if the earbud light does not flash, charge the case for 10+ minutes).
Close the case lid, then open it. The earbuds enter Bluetooth pairing mode automatically; on Samsung phones a connect pop-up appears.
On other phones, turn on Bluetooth and pick 'Galaxy Buds FE' from the list (or use the Galaxy Wearable app).
If they are not found or already paired to another device: leave them in the open case and touch and hold both earbuds for more than 3 seconds. The earbud lights flash red and green in pairing mode.
Pairing mode turns off after 3 minutes; close and reopen the case to try again.
